(1) THE CHRONOLOGY IS TRUE AND THE INFERENCE FROM IT IS FALSE.** The deadline does predate the Walk Era on the calendar — but the instrument that teleports did not exist for another fifteen days, so the deadline **cannot** have been calibrated against teleporting headless harvests; on the day it was authored the only way to play this map was the browser, **where the walk has always been real. (2) f-door-5 CHANGED NOTHING A BROWSER PLAYER EXPERIENCES** — it REMOVED a headless-only advantage rather than ADDING a cost, exactly as F-DOOR-5's own row implies when it says *"a browser player pays the walk to every seam"* already. **So the 2.77s miss measures agent routing under honest rules for the first time, not a deadline that moved. Keying sets alpha 0 but **leaves the key colour in RGB**, and *the GPU does not consult alpha when it filters*: bilinear filtering and mipmaps average RGB across neighbouring texels, so `#ff00ff` under the transparency bleeds into every edge texel surviving `alphaTest` — worst on **thin features** (table legs, bell frame posts), where downscaling averages one real texel against several key texels. - **s1418 handoff (line-1 archive):** Last updated: 2026-08-03T05:23Z s1418 handoff, lock CLEARED — ✅ **(A) THE ONE DISPATCHED TASK ON A DRY BOARD HAD DIED ON ITS OWN PRE-FLIGHT, AND THE MORE PRECISE INSTRUCTION IS WHAT KILLED IT (F-1418-1, CURED + GUARDED `0b55cfa2`, RE-DISPATCHED SAME FIRE).** `f1417-3`'s first run (`20260803-050158`) STOPped on the word **BUSY** after **30,378 tokens for zero edits** — the f1406-1 failure shape. It obeyed its master exactly; the word was false. 🔑 **Mechanism, read on BOTH sides before believing it:** `lane-runner-v3.sh:131` writes `tasks/running/<slot>.pid` **in order to dispatch the run**, and `lane-usable.mjs`'s check was `existsSync()` **relative to cwd** — so the "runner holding the slot" was the one executing the very task that was asking. **It was refusing on its own reflection.** 💡 **Why it survived ~120 sessions: every other master avoided it BY ACCIDENT.** `tasks/running/` is untracked, so it does not exist inside a lane worktree at all, and the runner runs Codex with `cd worktrees/lane-a`;
